mentions.name: pyrs
mentions.description: A Python 3.14 interpreter written in Rust, built entirely with coding agents. It has grown to 350k lines, ships as native and WebAssembly binaries (with a limited wasm version runnable online), and a full CPython test suite benchmark is being added. Built for fun to test the limits of current coding agents, not to replace CPython.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A fully vibe coded python 3.14 interpreter in Rust: https://blueblazin.github.io/pyrs

Now at 350k lines. Native and wasm binaries (you can try the limited wasm version online). Currently adding a full CPython test suite benchmark.

Just for fun, not trying to replace CPython here. Mainly to test the limits of current coding agents.
